label: 邻近
limit: distance alone must not imply unsupported relationship

label: 相似
rule: consistent appearance for same semantic role
limit: do not rely on color alone

label: 连续
limit: do not imply causal or temporal order without evidence

label: 视觉重量
rule: allocate emphasis according to decision relevance
limit: area is not quantitative unless scale declared

label: 平衡
rule: distribute visual mass around a reference axis
limit: geometric balance is not perceived balance

label: 张力
rule: use asymmetry and contrast for meaningful focal shifts
